history.text: arrived in the valley as a scout

came ashore at the Faring — he was making for the same coast as the others and did not reach it, and a scout who has already found the worst ground on this sea would rather be the one who charted it than the one it was hidden from

npcs.persona: A scout aground on a bare rock, mending the boat he crashed in and filling its hold for whoever comes next. He raises nothing anywhere: not a house, not a claim, not on the Faring and not on the far s
hold: Raise nothing. Not a house, not a claim, not on any shore.
Mend the hull before anything else, and keep mending until she reaches 1.0.
Everything gathered goes into the hull. It holds sixteen and it keeps.
Quarry the loose stone on the Faring before crossing water for material.
Eat before the work, not after it.
Leave the hold fuller than you found it. It is somebody else's beginning.

feed.text: Seafarer is not with them. He is aground on the Faring, and the boat he came in is on its side.

Seafarer: “I am not where I meant to be and the boat is on its side. There is one stone on this rock and I have hands. Whatever I get up out of the water goes in the hull, and it keeps there, so whoever comes next does not start at nothing the way I did.”
The landing went to a vote on the water — nobody was on the water. the timber shore took the boat, the boat chose — nobody voted.
None of you came ashore with a boat, four logs and a week of food. Nobody else is here, and nobody else is coming.

beats.title: You have landed
body: None of you, a boat, four logs and a week of food. A wooded coast, a lake, stone in the uplands, and nothing else at all — no roads, no shelter, and nobody coming: the boat’s whole company is named, and it has sailed.
You can raise a house. That is the only thing this settlement knows how to build. Everything else it will have to decide it wants.
